title: Business Central to Microsoft Fabric is a mirror. But what if you want to know what actually changed?
summary: Business Central data mirrored to Microsoft Fabric appears as static copies by default, but partners can enable delta change data feeds to track table modifications and version history in the mirroring database using Fabric notebooks and SQL queries.
key_points: By default, Business Central tables are only mirrored into the Fabric mirroring database, and the connector does not expose changes
Enable the delta change data feed setting to capture changes to the mirrored tables
Create a shortcut to the mirroring database inside a lakehouse, then query it from a notebook
DESCRIBE HISTORY lists the table versions, and table_changes shows the change type, commit version and timestamp for each row
The example shows one customer's name being updated and another customer being newly inserted

quotes.text: the table in Business Central is replicated inside the mirroring database in Fabric
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that Fabric mirroring creates copies of BC tables for analytics

quotes.text: with this you can track all the data changes inside a table
quotes.why_it_matters: Summarizes the end goal of using delta change data feeds for audit and analytics
